  \draw[gray!35] (-1,-1) rectangle (4.1,3.1);
  \ctikzset{bipoles/length=1.8cm, bipoles/vsource/width=.24, bipoles/vsource/height=.9,

    voltage=straight, voltage/straight label distance=1.8}
